verdict.rationale: Mobile apps are a fair question for an AI assistant product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows Poke is delivered only through third-party messaging platforms (Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, RCS), which are host-platform channels rather than official Poke apps. No first-party iOS or Android app is documented.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android
